medios.titulo: Lightning events detected by the LIS sensor on the ISS between January 2017 and July 2023 using a 10-day roving window
medios.grupo: Lightning Events Detected from the International Space Station (ISS) 2017-2023
medios.descripcion: Lightning events detected by the LIS sensor on the ISS between January 2017 and July 2023 using a 10-day roving window. Data is from the quality controlled science dataset. Available resolution in the download menu are 1920x1080, 3840x2160 (4k), and 7680x2160 (created for EIC display).
